name: Sega Model 3
description: Sega's 1996 high-end 3D arcade board, built around a PowerPC CPU and Real3D graphics derived from Lockheed Martin simulation technology. At launch it was considered the most powerful arcade board available, running Virtua Fighter 3, Scud Race, Sega Rally 2 and Daytona USA 2.
curiosities: It was unveiled at the 1996 AOU show with Virtua Fighter 3.
The board was released in 'steps' (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.1), each raising the CPU clock.
By 2000, Sega had sold more than 200,000 Model 2 and Model 3 arcade systems combined.
Its games are emulated by Supermodel, a dedicated Model 3 emulator.
story: Sega's Model 3 arcade board of 1996 was one of the most powerful of its time, built with Lockheed Martin graphics technology.
Virtua Fighter 3, Daytona USA 2, Scud Race and Sega Rally 2 ran on it.
It was Sega's high point in 3D arcade graphics.
